summary: Initialize repository indexing and configuration.
problem_solved: Creates the persistent SQLite index (.codegraph.sqlite3) and sets up the project graph cache without requiring external DB infrastructure.
output: Initialized CodeGraph repository at /path/to/repo (indexed 190 files)

summary: Perform incremental AST & relationship indexing with 16-phase telemetry.
problem_solved: Detects modified or deleted files using content hashes and Git commits; only re-indexes what changed in milliseconds.
flags: --verbose, -v: Show phase-by-phase timings and memory usage
output:
Phase: Repository Scan [190/190 files, 100%] elapsed: 0.09s
Phase: Final Commit & Checkpoint
scanned=190 indexed=1 unchanged=189 removed=0

summary: Inspect index freshness, file counts, and resource consumption in < 5ms.
problem_solved: Eliminates slow full-repo scans before queries by checking git commit HEAD match and working tree status instantly.
output:
{
  "status": "FRESH",
  "files": 190,
  "symbols": 1944,
  "graph_edges": 14293,
  "resource_profile": "BALANCED"
}

summary: Verify SQLite schema integrity, foreign keys, FTS search, and orphaned processes.
problem_solved: Detects database corruption, schema mismatches, duplicate canonical symbol IDs, and stale background processes.
flags: --database: Run deep schema & foreign key checks
--processes: Audit active MCP processes and parent PIDs

summary: Zero-friction runtime telemetry interceptor.
problem_solved: Bypasses the complexity of setting up OpenTelemetry or Pino streaming. Injects lightweight NODE_OPTIONS or PYTHONSTARTUP hooks to record live HTTP routes, latencies, and uncaught exceptions directly into SQLite.
example:
codegraph run npm run dev
# or
codegraph run uvicorn main:app --reload
output:
>> Dev server active on port 8000
[CodeGraph Runtime Interceptor: Captured 14 HTTP spans -> .codegraph/runtime.sqlite3]

summary: Run the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over stdio or SSE HTTP.
problem_solved: Connects AI coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Antigravity) to the repository intelligence graph via JSON-RPC standard I/O or persistent SSE HTTP.
flags: --profile <name>: Tool profile (core | minimal | agent | developer | full)
output: CodeGraph MCP server running on http://127.0.0.1:8765/sse (62 tools registered)

summary: Safely terminate active CodeGraph background processes and release SQLite file locks.
problem_solved: Prevents "database is locked" crashes by gracefully signalling MCP servers to close connections before unmounting or updating.
flags: --all, -a: Stop all CodeGraph processes across all repositories

summary: Idempotently detect and configure AI coding agents.
problem_solved: Eliminates manual JSON config editing. Detects Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Cline, and Codex; injects mcpServers and safe marker-bounded instructions.
output:
Configured Claude Code (CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json)
Configured Cursor (.cursor/mcp.json, .cursorrules)
Configured Antigravity (.agents/mcp_config.json, AGENTS.md)

summary: Search symbols and text chunks with AST-verified evidence.
problem_solved: Combines SQLite FTS5 lexical matching with exact symbol grounding; returns exact file lines, content hashes, and match confidence.

summary: Compile token-budgeted ContextPacket for an AI agent task.
problem_solved: Selects the top high-signal symbols and slices needed for a specific task intent (DEBUG, TRACE, REVIEW) fitting strictly within a token budget.
flags: --intent <str>: Task intent (UNDERSTAND | DEBUG | TRACE | REVIEW | IMPACT)
example: codegraph context "fix order validation error" --intent DEBUG
output:
ContextPacket compiled (540 tokens, reduction: 78.4%):
  - 4 confirmed symbols, 2 database tables, 1 covering test

summary: Verify repository privacy boundaries and ensure no sensitive data is indexed.
problem_solved: Scans SQLite database to guarantee that .env files, RSA private keys, JWTs, and database credentials have been redacted and never saved.
output: Privacy Audit PASSED: 0 sensitive files indexed, 0 exposed secrets found.

summary: Detect semantic and contract merge conflicts between branches before merge.
problem_solved: Flags silent merge conflicts that standard Git merges miss—such as branch A calling a function or route handler that branch B deleted or altered.
